name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible APKM/APKG problem
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## Environment
APKM version; Linux distribution or Termux; Android version and ABI; adb/root backend.

## Reproduction
Exact command, expected result and actual result.

## Output
Redacted error output and `apkm doctor` / `adb devices` results. Remove serials, pairing codes, credentials and private keys.

## Checks
Does it also happen with apkg directly? Was this tested on a physical device or a mock?
